annotations.title: Read one article of an Iranian law

description: Read the full text of one article of an Iranian statute or regulation, word for word, with its law, the details on its page, a warning when it is marked repealed, and its dadrasai.com link. Use it when the article is known — named by the user or returned by another tool as a slug or link; to find which article covers a subject, use search_iranian_law instead. Dadras's explanatory notes, when present, follow the text under a heading that marks them as not part of the law. When the article is missing, the result says whether the law itself was found and gives its slug and article count for list_law_articles.

article.description: The article number, in Persian or Latin digits, e.g. «۱۰», «296», «۲۹۶ مکرر». Used with `law`.

law.description: The law's Persian name, full or short — «قانون مجازات اسلامی», «قانون مدنی». Used with `article`.

slug.description: Instead of law and article: an article slug or a dadrasai.com/laws/… link from another tool's result.

name: get_law_article

links.description: The dadrasai.com pages the result cites, in order.

text.description: The result, in Persian, as it should be quoted.
